fields.mechanism: Hydatid cyst wall integrity disruption via mechanical shear

fields.mechanism: Local drug delivery of albendazole reduces proteinaceous debris and clot formation in fluid systems.

fields.expected_effect: Maintains CSF drainage patency for the required monitoring period without systemic anticoagulation.
fields.falsification_test: In vitro flow loop with CSF analog and blood clotting agents, measuring patency time with and without magnetic activation of the drug‑releasing coating.
